[[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] wore '''durasteel-toed boots''', also known simply as '''naval boots''', as part of their standard [[Imperial officer's uniform/Legends|uniform]]. Some [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] wore [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]]-toed combat boots.
